news.title: South Korea blocks 27 crypto exchanges, including Bitmart and Kucoin
news.summary: The country’s regulators are stepping up their earlier restrictions on mobile apps to websites, targeting unregistered exchanges before investors report losses.

news.title: UK crypto trader says almost $800,000 lost in knife assault as wrench attacks proliferate
news.summary: A crypto trader in the U.K. claimed masked intruders stole nearly $800,000 in cryptocurrency at knifepoint, furthering concerns of "wrench attacks" spreading in the country.

news.title: Crypto exchange MNX takes on OKX, Bitget offering pre-IPO futures for AI giants
news.summary: MNX is offering a different way to trade the future valuations of private AI companies, including OpenAI, Anthropic and DeepSeek.

news.title: Strive raising $500 million to buy additional bitcoin with new preferred share class
news.summary: SATS will offer a fixed 15% dividend yield at par and be junior to the company's existing SATA, which pays a variable rate (currently 13%).

news.title: Largest Philippines crypto exchange, Coins.ph, said to face central bank regulatory action
news.summary: The exchange, which has over 18 million customers, is said to have handled business transactions involving restricted offshore gaming and gambling companies.

news.title: Bitcoin climbs toward $84,000 after Fed’s Williams sees no rate hikes in 2027
news.summary: ZEC led a broad bounce among major tokens, and Korean chipmakers snapped a five-day losing streak ahead of Thursday’s U.S. inflation data.

news.title: Coinbase, which holds 5% of all bitcoin, wants the quantum fix started now
news.summary: Coinbase says bitcoin should start preparing for quantum computers now, with flexible addresses, a backup quantum-proof key and a separate debate over lost coins.
